purpose: Freeze exact BACE1 development, fresh-validation, and locked-test ligand identities before Stage42 development docking, while keeping source-ID, canonical-SMILES, and Bemis-Murcko groups indivisible.

decoy_allocation.grouping_rule: Connected components formed by shared DUD-E source molecule ID, canonical isomeric SMILES, or achiral Bemis-Murcko scaffold. Exclude every component colliding with any selected active canonical SMILES or scaffold.
decoy_allocation.assignment_rule: For development, validation, then test, sort remaining groups by SHA-256 of the role-specific seed and deterministic group ID; admit a group only when it does not overshoot the exact row count.

interpretation_boundary: This stage freezes ligand identities and labels only. It reads no docking score, prepares no validation or test ligand, and cannot rescue Stage41c or provide enrichment, QUBO, or quantum evidence.
